description: This file defines React components and hooks related to displaying error information in a trace viewer UI, including error rendering, code frame generation, and error model management.

classes.name: CopyPromptButton
classes.description: A React component that renders a button to copy a prompt string to clipboard.

methods.name: useErrorsTabModel
methods.description: Custom hook that creates a model of errors from a TraceModel.

methods.name: ErrorView
methods.description: React component that displays an individual error message with location and action.

methods.name: ErrorsTab
methods.description: Main React component that displays a list of errors, fetches error context, and generates code frames.

methods.name: codeFrame
methods.description: Function that generates a code snippet with highlighted error line and message.
